chunks: From a spring of which the votaries of God will drink and make it flow in abundance.
ai.seo_question: What is the spring that the servants of God will drink from in Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tafjir* (causing to flow), emphasizing the active role of the righteous in accessing and enjoying divine bounty. The spring is interpreted not merely as a physical source but as a symbol of the pure, flowing knowledge and spiritual vitality granted to the *Ibad Allah* in the afterlife, distinct from the rivers of Paradise mentioned in other verses.
